sources.snippet: VietQuill is a unified framework for Vietnamese paraphrase generation, evaluation, and quality control, supporting both research and production applications. We are committed to advancing Vietnamese paraphrase generation by making state-of-the-art methods accessible, customizable, and easy to integrate into real-world workflows. - ngwgsang/vietquill
